subject: rstan doesn't realise that my model has changed...

messages.author: cf47bbe63da1f3ae
messages.subject: rstan doesn't realise that my model has changed...
parts: I wish I could post a reproducible example, but it happens to me quite regularly that I make changes to my rstan model code and then go to compile, but it happens very quickly and the model is unchanged. I then need to close and reopen rstudio to be able to compile the model. Is there anything I can check or change in this regard?

I wish I could post a reproducible example, but it happens to me quite regularly that I make changes to my rstan model code and then go to compile, but it happens very quickly and the model is unchanged. I then need to close and reopen rstudio to be able to compile the model. Is there anything I can check or change in this regard?
